messages:
Alex Chen: Heads-up — Datadog asked for a joint observability bundle we can publish to AWS Marketplace alongside the Dedicated offering. Aim: dashboard + tracing + quickstart for GPU telemetry. Launch target: 2026-05-12.
Priya Nair: Love it. Do we mean a Marketplace packaged AMI/CloudFormation or just a dashboard bundle + docs?
Alex Chen: Start with dashboard bundle + OTEL collector config + a one-click dashboard install; Marketplace listing can link to the bundle. Keep AMI for phase 2.
Tomás Alvarez: For tracing tags we should add model_id, shard_id, request_tier (hosted/dedicated/private). That lets customers filter latency regressions by model/version.
Dana Kim: Agreed. Also include resource metrics for GPU: memory_used, sm_util, power_draw. Datadog has GPU integrations but we should map metric names in the quickstart.
Alex Chen: @Priya can you own the Datadog marketplace doc and listing copy? @Tomás take the tracing schema + OTEL config. I'll coordinate the dashboard tiles and screenshots.
Priya Nair: I can. I'll draft copy this week and get legal review for the co-marketing blurb. ETA: 4/10 for first pass.
Tomás Alvarez: Placing sample OTEL collector config here for review:
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  batch: {}
  attributes:
    actions:
      - key: model_id
        action: insert
        value: "{{env:MODEL_ID}}"
exporters:
  datadog:
    api:
      key: ${DD_API_KEY}
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch, attributes]
      exporters: [datadog]
```
Tomás Alvarez: Note: we add a small middleware to attach request_tier and shard_id on the server side before sending OTLP.
Datadog Bot: Thanks — Datadog engineering will provide a dashboard JSON + recommended queries. Expect initial bundle by 2026-04-15.
Dana Kim: We should include a short regression playbook in the docs: how to triage a spike (check model_id -> shard -> env -> top span time). I'll draft steps.
Alex Chen: Ops note: dashboards must have a low-resources default; some customers have telemetry disabled for cost reasons. Include an example with sampling 1% + KV cache metrics.
Priya Nair: Marketing coordination: want a small joint blog post + tweet thread on launch day. Need quotes from Datadog; legal ok with co-branded logos? (cc @Dana)
Dana Kim: Legal asked for logo guidelines. I'll surface the guidelines doc and collect assets.
Tomás Alvarez: Going to open a PR with the tracing schema + unit tests for span attributes. Link will be posted here once ready.
Alex Chen: Cool — weekly sync scheduled Fridays 9am PT starting 2026-03-27. Agenda: dashboard review, OTEL config, marketplace copy, demo plan.
Priya Nair: :thumbsup: Putting action items in the shared doc: https://brief.link/rw-observability-bundle
Tomás Alvarez: Demo idea: 3-minute video showing end-to-end request -> trace -> dashboard drilldown for a cold-start vs cached prefix.
Datadog Bot: Reminder: include recommended links to Datadog APM pricing and ingestion controls in the docs to prevent surprise bills.
Alex Chen: Nice. If nothing else, we'll sync next Friday. Thanks all.
